name: Electric Arc
desc: Slow plasma filaments crawl and re-route from a glowing core — a plasma-globe or Tesla arc that writhes and branches continuously (never a strike, never a strobe), over a soft violet halo and faint ionized haze; charged light over any dark scene.

style.doc: plasma_globe=violet-magenta core, cyan tips / tesla=electric blue-white / arc_weld=hot white-blue / faraday=green-cyan, eerie
